segments.sn36.9:1.1: “Tisso imā, bhikkhave, vedanā aniccā saṅkhatā paṭiccasamuppannā khayadhammā vayadhammā virāgadhammā nirodhadhammā.
segments.sn36.9:1.3: Sukhā vedanā, dukkhā vedanā, adukkhamasukhā vedanā –
segments.sn36.9:1.4: imā kho, bhikkhave, tisso vedanā aniccā saṅkhatā paṭiccasamuppannā khayadhammā vayadhammā virāgadhammā nirodhadhammā”ti.

lines: 256-257. Aṭṭhame imameva phassaṃ paṭiccāti vutte bujjhanakānaṃ ajjhāsayena vuttaṃ, atthato panetaṃ ninnānākaraṇaṃ.
Na hi phassāyatanehi vinā phassassa sambhavo.
Tenāha “kāyova hi ettha phassoti vutto”ti, phassasīsena vuttoti adhippāyo.
